overview: December 1949 airgram reports Japan authorized to open Japan-Formosa radiotelephone service around January 1950, with set call charges.

subfiles.title: Airgram on Japan–Formosa radiotelephone service
subfiles.from: U.S. Political Adviser, Tokyo (William J. Sebald)
subfiles.about: Reports the authorization, anticipated opening, and rates of a radiotelephone circuit between Japan and Formosa.
subfiles.summary: Airgram reports Japan's Telecommunications Ministry authorized radiotelephone service with Formosa from about January 1950, at 2,160 yen for three minutes, 720 yen per additional minute, and 216 yen report charge.

interest: Tracks planned 1949 Japan-Formosa radiotelephone service and tariffs.
